content:
nina_sales: EdgeConnect security sent back a questionnaire. Requests: Private deployment, original client source IP for their WAF, a single static outbound IP for allowlisting, and confirmation on TLS inspection compatibility. Need a short options summary + firewall snippet and a POC-level monthly delta for procurement.

wes_netops: Summary: VPC peering / Transit GW preserves client src IP end-to-end. PrivateLink (interface endpoint) does NOT preserve src IP; traffic will come from the endpoint ENI. To provide a single static egress IP you need SNAT via a NAT/GW with an EIP in the egress path (transit account or managed egress).

claire_se: Common patterns we propose:
1) Peering/Transit to our Private VPC (preserves srcip). Needs non-overlapping CIDRs and route propagation.
2) PrivateLink + light proxy in customer's VPC that forwards X-Forwarded-For (requires trusting headers).
3) Managed static egress NAT (single EIP) if allowlist is mandatory  note this breaks native src IP unless paired with proxy.

omar_infosec: TLS inspection caveat: transparent MITM will break cert-pinning. If inspection is required, recommend termination at a customer-controlled proxy or sidecar. We support customer-managed KMS on Private and audit export (30/90/365d) and HSM-backed keywrap on request.

nina_sales: Minimal ACL snippet to share with their network team and ballpark cost deltas?

wes_netops: ACL example (replace CIDRs/EIP):
```
# Allow outbound from app subnets to Redwood Private
ALLOW OUT TCP 443 FROM 10.200.0.0/22 TO 203.0.113.0/25
# If using managed single EIP for static egress
NAT 10.200.0.0/22 -> 54.210.99.10
```
Ballpark POC deltas (very rough): Hosted = pay-per-use tokens. Dedicated reserved = ~$6k-$20k/month depending on tier. Private deployment baseline (POC infra + license) = ~$10k-$35k/month. Add managed static egress = +$700-$2k/month + per-GB egress. Exact pricing from Sales Ops.

claire_se: Ops caveats: if they need client IP for rate limits, prefer peering or run a proxy in their VPC. Document the trust boundary if using X-Forwarded-For. Also share conntrack scaling if NAT in path.

omar_infosec: I'll draft the security wording for their questionnaire (KMS, audit retention, TLS inspection compatibility).

nina_sales: Can someone join a handoff call tomorrow 10:30am PT to finalize CIDRs and NAT EIP?

wes_netops: I'll join. I'll bring route table and NAT sizing.

claire_se: I'll join for header propagation guidance.

meeting-bot: Scheduled: EdgeConnect-network-handoff on 2025-06-18 10:30 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/edgeconnect-4842001110

nina_sales: Perfect 44d I'll send the invite to EdgeConnect and attach the ACL + draft security QA. Action items: Wes -> precise NAT/EIP cost and route table example; Claire -> X-Forwarded-For guidance; Omar -> finalize security statements.
